guard: The test-only issued lifecycle stages source indexes before the existing agent-mint fence, activates only at the original prepared revision and refuses resolution after revocation. This is a localhost gate-composition proof, without production issuer or barrier attachment.

mutations.name: existing finalizer is not awaited
mutations.expectRed: release waits for the pending existing finalizer before activation
mutations.cell: release waits for the pending existing finalizer before activation

mutations.name: source index writes are omitted
mutations.find: await kv.create(sourceIndexKey(source, evidence.ref), bytes({ source, ref: evidence.ref }));
mutations.expectRed: release runs the existing finalizer after durable evidence and indexes
mutations.cell: release runs the existing finalizer after durable evidence and indexes

mutations.name: source index omits the permission generation
mutations.expectRed: two issuances of one root credential retain distinct generation indexes
mutations.cell: two issuances of one root credential retain distinct generation indexes

mutations.name: activation takes a fresh revision after abort
mutations.find: bytes({ version: 1, state: "active", digest: snap.digest }), snap.revision
mutations.expectRed: a winning source fence followed by prepared retirement loses activation
mutations.cell: a winning source fence followed by prepared retirement loses activation

mutations.name: retirement skips prepared attempts
mutations.expectRed: source freeze before finalization releases nothing and aborts the attempt
mutations.cell: source freeze before finalization releases nothing and aborts the attempt

mutations.name: resolution ignores source revocation
mutations.find: if (!await sourceIsLive(source)) throw new Error("issued source is not live");
mutations.expectRed: activation before the source walk is irreversibly revoked
mutations.cell: activation before the source walk is irreversibly revoked

mutations.name: resolution skips its final state check
mutations.expectRed: resolution rechecks revocation after awaiting source authorization
mutations.cell: resolution rechecks revocation after awaiting source authorization

mutations.name: attempt digest no longer binds immutable evidence
mutations.expectRed: modified evidence fails its attempt digest before returning permissions
mutations.cell: modified evidence fails its attempt digest before returning permissions
